messages:
erin (design): quick design review notes on the routing policies editor preview. found 4 small but annoying UX/accessibility bits after compact-mode merge: reorder announcements, focus loss on preview update, badge copy+visibility, and preview collapse behavior on narrow widths. looping @josh @meera
ryan (pm): thanks erin. can you give repro + suggested copy?
erin (design): repro: Policy > Rules > enable compact preview > add 6 rules > narrow to 420px > drag reorder > run simulation. issues: 1) SR just says 'list updated' after reorder, 2) focus jumps to top when preview rerenders, 3) validation pill hides behind header at <560px, 4) summary toast isn't keyboard reachable. copy recs: move: 'Moved "{rule}" to position {n}'; conflict short: 'Priority conflict	6 unreachable' (aria: 'Priority conflict, rule unreachable'); summary: 'Simulation complete	6 11 matched, 2 fallback'.
josh (frontend): can repro. we remount the preview and that kills focus; also aria-live region is inside the preview and gets unmounted. quick fixes: keep a singleton sr-announcer outside the preview, make the toast role=status + tabbable, and make badge keyboard-focusable (button with aria-describedby).
meera (eng): agree. i'll implement srAnnouncer singleton with assertive for per-action moves and polite for summaries. plan to debounce move announcements to 150ms to avoid floods, but ensure final summary always fires. we'll also avoid full unmounts — reuse list DOM where possible.
ops-jane: small ops note: when the sim runs with many rules we sometimes see many announcements causing audible spam. debouncing is good. also we should allow an opt-out in settings for verbose SR announcements for power users.
josh (frontend): CSS fix: badge used token purple-60 on purple-100 and fails contrast. i'll bump to purple-80 with white text and change absolute positioning so the pill wraps instead of overlapping the preview header. drag handle tab order: will make it first with aria-label='Drag to reorder'.
a11y-bot: scan results: violations found: 1) color contrast fail on .rule-badge (2.7:1), 2) live region remounted during preview updates, 3) drag handle missing aria-label & role. recommended: increase contrast to >=4.5:1, keep live region mounted, add role=button + aria-label to handle.
eryan (pm): I'll file tickets: INF-3801 sr-announcer + debounce, INF-3802 badge keyboard + contrast + copy, INF-3803 preserve-focus-on-preview-update. target: branch this sprint, PRs by Thu.
erin (design): extra UX ask: can we add a tiny "How this reads" toggle in the simulation panel that shows the last announcement text (short/verbose modes)? writers find it useful and it's low-risk.
meera (eng): we can expose the srAnnouncer's last message in a visible box behind a toggle; TTS later. adding as subtask to INF-3801.
josh (frontend): ok i'll prototype the visible preview for copy first and ensure keyboard focus stays stable during animation.
eryan (pm): perfect. let's test NVDA + VoiceOver + keyboard. assign owners and mark for accessibility QA. thanks all :rocket:
